exposure: HELLP syndrome (Haemolysis, Elevated Liver enzymes and Low Platelets)
cohort: A thirty-year-old pregnant woman who developed severe complications requiring critical care.
finding: This case report details the severe presentation of HELLP syndrome requiring emergency caesarean section and subsequent multidisciplinary critical care management for multiorgan support.
mod_finding: An emergency caesarean section was performed as the definitive treatment for HELLP syndrome.
